summary: Conjugate the lattice into R by the matrix P (IsLatticeIn); the local clauses of the column at the place above ℓ (finite type, jumps, goodness off g) transfer to the lattice by jointly injective comparison maps and base change of jumps.

steps.claim: Not a step of the proof: the rest of the statement (v, J and the conclusion), which the line census counts as part of the value because the statement contains `let v :=`.
steps.lean:
matrixLattice (u.comp (decompGroup _ (placeOver w.1)).subtype)
  let J g := τ (complexEmbOf ((localChart ℓ _ w).e.comp (algebraMap ..)) g)
  IsLatticeIn R u → (∀ g, HasJumps v.ρ (coeffEmb O g) (J g)) ∧ InClass (⨅ _ : ↑w ∈ placesAboveG
    D, ⊥) (fun s Q ↦ w.1 ∈ placesAboveG D ∧ ∀ R, 𝓡 R → ∃ P, PolyKillsAt R (placeOver w.1) s.1 P ∧
    ∀ y, P.IsRoot y → Q.aeval y = 0) (toFinset ∘ J ∘ surjInv coeffEmb_surjective) v := by

steps.claim: Local clauses of the column at the chosen place above w: finite type (c), jumps (d), goodness off g (z).
steps.lean: let ⟨⟨_, c⟩, d, z⟩ := h.local_conditions _ (by simp) w.1.isPlaceOver_placeOver

steps.claim: Introduce v, J and P with u(g) = P⁻¹R(g)P.
Let L be the linear equivalence given by P.
Let F be L after the inclusion O^n ⊆ ℚ̄_ℓ^n.
F is equivariant: F(v.ρ(g)x) = R(g)·F(x) on the decomposition group.
steps.lean:
have hf g x : F (v.ρ g x) = decompRep R _ g (F x) := congr(L $(funext
    (O.1.val.1.map_mulVec _ x))).trans (hP g ▸ by simp [L, F, mul_assoc]; rfl)
steps.typed_fact: F (v.ρ g x) = decompRep R _ g (F x)

steps.claim: It suffices to show the jump statement: then InClass follows by joint injectivity (of_jointly_injective) from the potential crystallinity of R at w (crystalline off g, z), the jump sets, and the killing polynomials at inertia, which pass through F (the linear Frobenius commutes with the coefficient endomorphisms: commute_coefEnd_linearFrob).
steps.lean:
suffices _ from ⟨this,
    .of_jointly_injective le_sup_left (by by_cases ↑w ∈ placesAboveG D <;> simp [*, (z _).2]) _
    (fun _ ↦ .of_forall hf) ?I, by simp [← count_ne_zero, ← this .., surjInv_eq], fun s Q k hs ↦
    (k.2 R m).rec fun _ ⟨a, _⟩ ↦ .of_jointly_injective hs _ (by tauto) ?I le_top (fun _ ↦ ⟨c,
    map_eq_zero_of_roots (eval₂RingHom' _ _ (commute_coefEnd_linearFrob c hs))
    ((((mapClusterPt_one_atTop_pow _).frequently (mem_comap'.1 c.eventually_linearFrob_eq_one)).mono
    (by simpa [← linearFrob_pow c hs ·] using · (map_pow ..) (hs.pow _))).forall_exists_of_atTop 1)
    (a.2 hs).2 (by simpa [eval_map])⟩) rfl fun () _ _ ↦ L.map_smul ..⟩

steps.claim: Jumps: base change of jumps along F (jump_baseChange) identifies the jumps of v at coeffEmb O g with those of R at the corresponding embedding, which are J(g) (d).
steps.lean:
any_goals intro g _; rw [coeffEmb, ← jump_baseChange ⟨F.1, fun _ _ ↦ L.map_smul
    ..⟩ (basisFun ..) ((basisFun ..).map L) (fun _ ↦ congr(L $(by ext; simp [apply_ite])))
    (.of_forall hf), ← @d _ _ g]
